scripts.clean:next: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['.next','.next-dev','.next-build']){try{fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}for(const f of ['.next.lock','.next-dev.lock','.next-build.lock']){try{fs.rmSync(f,{force:true})}catch(e){}}"
scripts.clean:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['.next']){try{fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}}for(const f of ['.next.lock']){try{fs.rmSync(f,{force:true})}catch(e){}}"
